title: He asked repeatedly.
text: “…Ah, I think I’ll go cool my head for a bit. I’ll head back to the tent first, if you’ll excuse me.”
“Sure thing. Take Théodore with you.”
“And we should bring Wolf along too.”
“Right. I’ll leave it to you.”
With Father’s permission, the mixed-blood lizardman bowed and left the tavern, taking Wolf and the rabbit man with him.
“…Well, that got a bit heavy. Big Sister was being a little childish too. Sorry about that, Naofumi-chan.”
“It’s fine. I just keep thinking about how hard things must have been for everyone.”

Despite having gone through such a disaster, the nation of Melromarc was busy squabbling amongst itself, carefree as ever—clear proof that they viewed the suffering of demi-humans and beastmen as trivial. What a disgrace, Father had apparently muttered when he later spoke with me about it.
“I understand Sadeena-san has her own feelings about this. I’m sure Shion has her reasons too.”
“That’s true. Even just talking with Shion-chan a little, you can tell she’s carrying something.”
“I’ve gotten pretty good at picking up on that sort of thing lately, but I do wish she’d just tell us.”
“Oh myyy.”
“That goes for you too, Sadeena-san.”
“Of course it does, Naofumi-chan. So, speaking of which—won’t Motoyasu-chan have a drink with Big Sister?”
Whoa, was the target shifting to me next!? Drinking against Older Sister was more than I could handle, I say. Even against Panda I end up dead drunk.
“Father, I’d like you to get along nicely with Older Sister, indeed.”
“Yeah, yeah. Sadeena-san, go easy on drinking everyone under the table for fun, okay? I’ll be your partner.”
“Indeed! Father is quite the formidable drinker—he won’t lose to Older Sister!”
“Oh, he really is strong. Well then, shall we have a drinking contest? By the way, is there some reason you call Big Sister ‘Big Sister’s Older Sister’?”
“Because she’s Big Sister’s older sister, indeed.”
Father gave a wry laugh at that.
“Motoyasu-kun calls Raphtalia-chan ‘Big Sister,’ you see. So since she’s that Big Sister’s older sister, Sadeena-san becomes Older Sister.”
“Oh myyy.”
“Motoyasu-kun has all sorts of reasons for things. Would you believe me if I said he came from the future? He’s the one who saved Raphtalia-chan, actually.”
And so Father explained the circumstances while trading cups with Older Sister.
“Father. If at all possible, I’d like you to get very close with Older Sister, indeed. That alone would lead to a good outcome, I say.”

If possible, I’d like him to hook up and graduate from virginity before Rival arrives. I’d sent her off to another world, but knowing Rival, I couldn’t rule out the possibility that she’d find some means of coming here regardless. That one’s coming—I could feel it, absolutely certain. As her rival, I had to give credit where it was due; she wasn’t someone to be underestimated. She was definitely coming. And yet here Father and the others were, taking their sweet time when something needed to be done. Would bringing Panda in prompt some action? No, Panda was fairly leisurely about these things too. What could possibly get Father to graduate from virginity?
“Oh myyy.”
“The more Older Sister comes to know Father’s depths, the more she’s bound to appreciate his charm, indeed.”
“Charm, huh…”
“Drink more! Trade more cups! Bring the sake, more and more, indeed!”

Clap, clap! I struck my hands together and ordered more drinks, resolving to deepen the bond between Father and Older Sister. I already had a firm grasp on Father’s preferences—I simply had to make sure he found himself a partner.
“S-somehow, Motoyasu-kun, aren’t you pushing kind of hard?”
“Not at all, indeed. Now then, Older Sister—drink up, plenty of it, indeed.”
“Oh myyy, well then, I’ll take you up on that.”
“Father, you too—drink Older Sister right under the table, indeed!”
“Geez, I don’t know…”
I kept the sake flowing steadily to Father and the others. When it ran short, I brought entire barrels over from other establishments to keep the drinking going.
“Motoyasu-kun, bringing this much is starting to become a problem, you know? The shopkeepers are turning pale!”
“Keep it coming! Big Sister’s starting to have fun too!”

As the drinking contest with Father wore on, Older Sister grew more heated watching him remain perfectly unfazed the whole time. Her guarded attitude had softened considerably by now. Yes, indeed—if things kept going this way, Older Sister would end up drunk, and Father could vanish with her into the night, returning only at dawn. Surely it would work out. Surely!
“Uuugh…”
Oh, Elephant was groaning, thoroughly plastered.
“Pull yourself together, Elephant, indeed. I’ll carry you. Let’s get you back to everyone.”
“Uuugh… I can’t… let Kou-san and the others see me… like this…”
Remarkable—even this drunk, Elephant’s thoughts remained with Kou and the others. Not wanting to disillusion them by showing this drunken state—truly admirable and manly, I say.

“Understood, Elephant, indeed. Then tonight, I’ll carry you somewhere else. Now then, Father. I’ll leave the rest to you, indeed. Please take your time and thoroughly enjoy a pleasant evening with Older Sister, then return at dawn. Yes—spend the night together in the same bed at the inn, indeed.”
“No, why are you getting that specific about it?”
“Older Sister is currently in her orca form, but she’s also capable of taking a demi-human form, so I do hope you’ll get to admire that beautiful figure of hers, indeed.”
“Oh myyy?”

Father seemed rather dumbfounded by all this, but I did want him to get properly close with Older Sister. Still, knowing bashful Father as I did… tonight probably wouldn’t go well. In all the previous loops, what was the fastest it had ever taken for him to form a relationship with Older Sister? Probably the loop where, unable to save her from the false accusation, Older Sister ended up taking Big Sister’s position instead—that was likely the quickest. In any case, considering everything so far, it was important to push a bit harder, confirm things properly, and get this settled before Rival arrived. I vaguely recalled the spirit of the spear saying something about “you should just tackle her,” but I tossed that notion aside! Drive mode, engines revving, indeed!
“Well then, off we go, Elephant, indeed!”
“Uuugh… excuse… me…”
“Yeah. Motoyasu-kun, Elmelo-san, see you later…”

And so, I took Elephant and brought her somewhere she could rest safely, indeed. Along the way, some fools accused me of being a fake and picked a fight, so I paralyzed them and took them captive. Tonight’s drinking money, secured, indeed.

The next morning, after I asked Father repeatedly whether he’d lost his virginity, he made me sit in formal seiza for an hour while he lectured me. Older Sister, having reconsidered, seemed to have taken quite a liking to Father, and the distance between them had shrunk noticeably compared to the day before. This might be it, indeed… if going through Father directly proved too difficult, perhaps asking Older Sister instead would be the faster route.

Or so I thought, indeed. Though, Older Sister was quite the crafty one herself… she wouldn’t simply nod along obediently to my circumstances. A difficult problem, indeed. Perhaps because she was already fulfilled in some sense? Thinking back on the incident where Father confessed to Older Sister, it seemed largely driven by the fact that Older Sister, believing Big Sister to be dead, had been driven into a corner of despair.

Wanting to be of use while her dependable little sister was suffering… truly Father’s kind of gentleness, indeed. Back then, Older Sister had apparently been described as feral—driven half-mad, it seemed, by grief over losing Big Sister combined with love for Father. That’s likely why she’d wanted a child as proof of that love with Father. Or so Itsuki, I believe, had mentioned once, indeed.

Conversely, it seemed Older Sister’s relationship also progressed faster in scenarios where Father was suffering under a false accusation. Was misfortune truly what deepened love, then…? A difficult matter indeed. Misfortune… and yet, in Big Sister’s case, why did things never seem to develop into that sort of relationship? Specifically, I mean the pattern from Father’s very first world. With Older Sister there’d been some hint of a connection forming, but with Big Sister, nothing of the sort seemed to happen.

Motoyasu, that’s far enough. Someone seemed to whisper in my ear, and the memory of nearly being beaten to death by Big Sister with a hammer came flooding back. Hmm… in any case, I absolutely had to get Father to graduate from virginity properly. Otherwise, he might well fall prey to Rival’s poisoned fangs.
『That’s not what Gaelion’s after anymore, nano. Would you just get that through your head already, nano.』
Rival said this inside my head, but I couldn’t believe it, indeed! You’re the one who already claimed Father’s virginity once before, so your crimes remain grave, indeed!
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun, are you even listening? Seriously, you don’t need to worry about my virginity, okay?”
“Understood. But Father, there’s no need to make such a fuss about it either, indeed.”
“Yeah, yeah.”
Honestly, now… Father simply let it go in one ear and out the other. Given how things were going, my hopes rested on Older Sister now, indeed.
